title: 10 Best Solidago Virgaurea Preparations

Teas made from the dried leaves and flowers are commonly used to support respiratory and digestive health. Decoctions, which involve boiling the plant material, are effective for extracting more potent compounds. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb for quick absorption and long-term use. Syrups and mucillages are often used to soothe inflammation and promote healing in the digestive tract.
